name: Old Stickfingers
description: An ancient guardian hearth spirit, tall and thin with antlers and too many green-glowing eyes, who is summoned by Arinos and kills those he thinks are intruders.

timeline.summary: The council explains the disappearances of Arinos and travelers and the death of Lakil; Malynn says that Old Stickfingers has come out of rhyme and story.
timeline.quote: "It was Old Stickfingers, it was," Malynn said.

timeline.summary: The two follow the tracks to an aspen grove where Old Stickfingers appears behind Vadrik.
timeline.quote: Old Stickfingers lived up to his name.

timeline.summary: Rem stabs Stickfingers and Vadrik blasts him with ice; Rem drives his blade through the creature's face and it vanishes.
timeline.quote: Rem stood up and drove his blade through the beast's chin, up through his face.

timeline.summary: Vadrik crushes the mobile with Stickfingers's blood on it, thinking this will unsummon him, and a keening comes from the alders.
timeline.quote: He then raised one boot and slammed it down, crushing the thing underfoot.

timeline.summary: The village bell tolls: Stickfingers is inside the walls, and Ariosa says that Vadrik and Rem set him free.
timeline.quote: "Just came from home," she said to Malynn, then she looked daggers at the pair of men. "They set him free."

timeline.summary: Malynn explains that Stickfingers is a hearth spirit of this place and cannot be sent away; Vadrik realizes he was summoned to protect, not to kill.
timeline.quote: "So he was summoned, not to kill, but to protect?"

timeline.summary: Vadrik works out that Arinos did not finish the summoning, so Stickfingers killed intruders on the old estate's land; Rem holds the monster back and Vadrik heals him.
timeline.quote: Killed Arinos as an intruder on his own land.

timeline.summary: Ariosa repairs the mobile and sings the binding, offering a goat; Stickfingers appears, accepts the goat and walks off peacefully as guardian of her home.
timeline.quote: Stickfingers barked, and the white goat ambled over to him.
